summary: 2026-27 home kit. Eight club partners per the club's own partnership page: Liga Stavok (premium partner, whose logo Stavki.ru reports is already on the kit), Moya Stikhiya, Domina, Synergetic, sprts.cc, Galeria, Therabody and Love Radio.
